title: the stage-gates proof's fixture cites a constraint source that git tracks, so its constrain and verdict teeth are green on every box
intention: The stage-gates proof's fixture constraint names a source that git holds, so the constrain gate's constraint_traces judge resolves it on every checkout and the proof is green wherever its code is.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendell: bin/cairn test of the stage-gates proof is red 2 of 8 (test_the_constrain_gate_reads_the_recorded_orient_berth, test_the_verdict_gate_disposes_from_the_observed_runs_not_the_draft), each refused with 'ConstrainRefused: constrain packet refused by the installed judges ...: [constraint_traces] constraint 0 names a source that does not resolve'. The fixture's source is press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt (proof line 98); git ls-tree origin/main lists no such file (deleted by e4a12d8, the outline became the schematic) and the Windows commons has none. The proof is green 8/8 on Linux (akienasus_cc_0), so a Linux copy probably lingers untracked: a green that rests on a file git does not hold.
traces_to: Law 3 (a green that leans on an untracked leftover is a claim); Law 8 (a proof must not lean on what git does not hold); Law 9 (a deterministic red is fixed, never explained as environmental).
how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: point the fixture's constraint source at press_office/INDEX.md, which origin/main tracks, and add a tooth that every source the fixture cites resolves through ref_exists on the committed tree. The judge is unchanged: a fabricated source still refuses.

clauses.claim: bin/cairn test of the stage-gates proof is 8 of 8 on Windows, where today the constrain and verdict teeth are refused at constraint_traces
every constraint source the proof's fixture cites is a file git tracks (git ls-files names it) and resolves through ref_exists

decisions.text: D1: the fixture's constraint source becomes press_office/INDEX.md, and the proof gains a tooth that each source it cites is tracked and resolves; PROVES declared for both clauses.

measured.saw: stage-gates proof red 2 of 8 on Windows at constraint_traces: constraint 0 source press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt does not resolve; git ls-tree origin/main press_office/ lists no CairnComponentOutline.txt; the Windows CairnCommons has none; Linux is green 8/8
measured.how: bin/cairn test of the proof on akiendell at 86cc-red-first-proof, then git ls-tree origin/main press_office/ and ls CairnCommons/press_office; Linux result relayed by akienasus_cc_0
